g.title: ATF_SENSOR
g.text: MaxxECU 1/8 NPT NTC temp sensor ID 1280 + 2-way DTM
CLT/water/oil NTC — threaded into Vibrant 16488 adapter in ATF return line

Non-polarity sensitive — either wire can be signal or GND. Sensor installed in Vibrant 16488 inline -8AN adapter, return line (post-Setrab cooler, before TCH-102-T2 entry back to trans). Thread sealant on 1/8 NPT threads; do not apply to AN threads.

g.title: W_ATF_TEMP_ENGINE
g.text: Sensor in transmission tunnel to bulkhead engine plug. Shielded preferred -- noisy environment (near drivetrain, ignition). Drain shield at bulkhead/ECU end only. Route along transmission tunnel away from coil primary wires.

g.title: BULKHEAD_ENGINE
g.text: Deutsch AS79 bulkhead — engine side (ATF temp pin)

g.title: BULKHEAD_CABIN
g.text: Deutsch AS79 bulkhead — cabin side (ATF temp pin)

g.title: W_ATF_TEMP_CABIN
g.text: Bulkhead cabin plug to MaxxECU CMC. Short cabin-side run.

g.title: ECU_CMC
g.text: MTune: Analog Inputs -- AIN 2 -- type = TEMPERATURE (enables 2.5k pullup). Calibrate to NTC curve: -20 deg C = 15,462 ohm, 130 deg C = 89 ohm. Assign function as extra temperature channel or Engine Oil Temperature. Do not configure as 0-5V -- requires internal pullup for NTC.
